summary: Frontend-only testing completed for TVUSVET medical/veterinary system. Key Dev Switcher and LicenseContext features working correctly, but patient creation issues prevent full clinical document workflow testing.

ui_bugs.issue: Modal overlay prevents form submission - clicks on 'Cadastrar Paciente' button timeout due to overlay interception
ui_bugs.impact: Blocks patient creation workflow and subsequent clinical document testing

integration_issues.issue: Created patients not appearing in patient list after form submission
integration_issues.impact: Cannot test full clinical document creation workflow without valid patients

navigation_issues.issue: Editor shows 'Paciente nao encontrado' (Patient not found) when using test patient IDs
navigation_issues.impact: Cannot test template filtering, print functionality, or edit mode features

passed_tests: Dev Switcher functionality - VET ↔ MD mode switching works perfectly
Form field adaptation based on practice context (Tutor vs Responsável/Acompanhante)

UI authentication and main app loading

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix patient creation modal overlay issues preventing form submission. The modal dialog overlay intercepts pointer events making the 'Cadastrar Paciente' button unclickable. This blocks testing of the CRITICAL clinical document creation workflow. Also investigate why created patients aren't persisting/appearing in the patient list.
